items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Yeah, Chico and there have been other people since

ctx.x: Let’s see — who else used it after that? Chico Hamilton, right?
Yeah, Chico and there have been other people since, but I think it’s a great sound.
I’m curious, did you listen to a lot of Bach and Vivaldi as a child?
